WITH revenue AS (SELECT ci.region_id, substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) AS year, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS rev FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) IN ('01', '02', '03', '04', '05', '06') GROUP BY ci.region_id, year) SELECT r1.name FROM revenue r2024 JOIN revenue r2025 ON r2024.region_id = r2025.region_id JOIN regions r1 ON r1.id = r2025.region_id WHERE r2024.year = '2024' AND r2025.year = '2025' ORDER BY ((r2025.rev - r2024.rev) * 1.0 / r2024.rev) DESC, r1.name LIMIT 1

WITH revenue AS (SELECT ci.region_id, substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) AS year, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS rev FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY ci.region_id, substr(o.order_date, 1, 4)) SELECT r1.name FROM regions r1 JOIN (SELECT region_id, (rev_2025 - rev_2024) / rev_2024 * 100 AS growth FROM (SELECT region_id, SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2024' THEN rev END) AS rev_2024, SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2025' THEN rev END) AS rev_2025 FROM revenue GROUP BY region_id) WHERE rev_2024 > 0) r2 ON r1.id = r2.region_id ORDER BY growth DESC LIMIT 1

WITH revenue AS (SELECT ci.region_id, substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) AS year, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS rev FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY ci.region_id, substr(o.order_date, 1, 4)) SELECT r1.name FROM regions r1 JOIN (SELECT region_id, (SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2025' THEN rev END) - SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2024' THEN rev END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2024' THEN rev END) * 100 AS growth FROM revenue GROUP BY region_id) r2 ON r2.region_id = r1.id ORDER BY growth ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT name FROM (SELECT r.name AS name, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date,1,4)='2025' THEN oi.quantity*oi.unit_price*(1-oi.discount_pct/100.0) ELSE 0 END) AS r25, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date,1,4)='2024' THEN oi.quantity*oi.unit_price*(1-oi.discount_pct/100.0) ELSE 0 END) AS r24 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date,1,4) IN ('2024','2025') AND substr(o.order_date,6,2) BETWEEN '07' AND '12' GROUP BY r.id) WHERE r24 > 0 ORDER BY (r25 - r24) * 1.0 / r24 ASC, name LIMIT 1

SELECT e.name FROM orders o JOIN employees e ON e.id = o.employee_id WHERE substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' GROUP BY e.id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) DESC, e.name LIMIT 1

SELECT e.name, ROUND(COALESCE(rev.r, 0) - COALESCE(ref.f, 0), 2) AS net_revenue FROM employees e JOIN (SELECT o.employee_id AS eid, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS r FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-09-30' GROUP BY o.employee_id) rev ON rev.eid = e.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.employee_id AS eid, SUM(rt.refund_amount) AS f FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN returns rt ON rt.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-09-30' GROUP BY o.employee_id) ref ON ref.eid = e.id ORDER BY net_revenue DESC, e.name LIMIT 3

SELECT substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) AS month FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2024' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipments s WHERE s.order_id = o.id) GROUP BY substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) ORDER BY CAST(COUNT(r.id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT oi.id) DESC, month LIMIT 1

SELECT e.name FROM employees e JOIN (SELECT o.employee_id AS eid, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS rev FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31' GROUP BY o.employee_id) r ON r.eid = e.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.employee_id AS eid, SUM(rt.refund_amount) AS ref FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN returns rt ON rt.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31' GROUP BY o.employee_id) f ON f.eid = e.id ORDER BY r.rev - COALESCE(f.ref, 0) DESC, e.name LIMIT 3

SELECT substr(o.order_date,1,7) AS month FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE substr(o.order_date,1,4) = '2025' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipments s WHERE s.order_id = o.id) GROUP BY substr(o.order_date,1,7) ORDER BY (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM returns rt JOIN order_items oi2 ON oi2.id = rt.order_item_id JOIN orders o2 ON o2.id = oi2.order_id WHERE substr(o2.order_date,1,7) = substr(o.order_date,1,7) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipments s2 WHERE s2.order_id = o2.id)) * 1.0 / COUNT(oi.id) DESC, month LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers c WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id) >= 5 AND (SELECT AVG((julianday(t.closed_at) - julianday(t.opened_at)) * 24) FROM support_tickets t WHERE t.customer_id = c.id AND t.closed_at IS NOT NULL) > (SELECT AVG((julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) * 24) FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL)

SELECT name FROM (SELECT r.name AS name, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date,1,4)='2025' THEN oi.quantity*oi.unit_price*(1-oi.discount_pct/100.0) ELSE 0 END) AS r25, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date,1,4)='2024' THEN oi.quantity*oi.unit_price*(1-oi.discount_pct/100.0) ELSE 0 END) AS r24 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id=c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id=ci.region_id WHERE o.status='delivered' AND substr(o.order_date,6,2) BETWEEN '01' AND '06' AND substr(o.order_date,1,4) IN ('2024','2025') GROUP BY r.id) ORDER BY (r25 - r24) * 1.0 / NULLIF(r24,0) ASC, name LIMIT 1

WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG((julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) * 24) AS avg_h FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL), cust_res AS (SELECT customer_id, AVG((julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) * 24) AS avg_h FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_id), cust_orders AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM cust_res cr JOIN cust_orders co ON co.customer_id = cr.customer_id WHERE cr.avg_h > (SELECT avg_h FROM overall) AND co.n >= 8

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND r.name = 'Tabuk' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' AND substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) IN ('07', '08', '09', '10', '11', '12')

SELECT name FROM (SELECT r.name AS name, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date,1,7) BETWEEN '2025-07' AND '2025-12' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) END) AS h25, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date,1,7) BETWEEN '2024-07' AND '2024-12' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) END) AS h24 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY r.id) WHERE h24 > 0 AND h25 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (h25 - h24) / h24 DESC, name LIMIT 1
